problem: After a fresh admission finishes, the metadata runner must start its SSH contact within 120 seconds and within 80 seconds of the metadata GO approval. Root review, stage-two finalization, the GO write and the launcher start all have to fit inside that window.

design.method: One Opus draft and one independent Fable draft, judged by a separate Opus auditor; root confirmed the cited gate lines in the accepted code.
design.chosen: A pre-armed operations session waits for root tickets. Root command A writes the admission GO and reviews the result against criteria fixed in advance. Root makes one live decision. Root command B then writes the release inputs, runs the accepted stage-two adapter and writes the metadata GO.
keyFacts: Contact deadline is the earlier of admission finish plus 120 seconds and metadata GO approval plus 80 seconds.
The runner must reach its contact gate within 4 seconds of its first budget sample.
Controller evidence and stage-two finalization run only after root reviews the admission, as the release-lineage contract requires.
Admission finish time is the admission receipt time.

windowLibrary.role: Pure checks and builders: 68 admission predicates, release inputs, both GO shapes, deadlines and the window contract.

opsSession.role: Single pre-armed process that starts each launcher once, only after a verified root ticket.

acceptedLocalCandidates.reviews: Each passed one correction round after an independent tester and an Opus audit; the operations session also had a Fable second opinion. Root confirmed every counted finding against the code.
limits: Synthetic inputs only; REAL mode has never run
A crash of the operations session while a launcher runs leaves the launcher outcome unknown
